# Lovable

> Lovable is an AI-powered no-code app builder that enables teams to create full-stack production applications collaboratively, with enterprise security and integrations for GitHub, Supabase, and other tools.

Lovable serves multiple user personas—from founders and product managers to designers, marketers, and operations teams—providing role-specific solutions for building interactive prototypes, internal tools, and production apps. The platform emphasizes speed, collaboration, and enterprise-grade security.

## Key Topics

- AI app builder
- No-code platform
- Full-stack development
- React & Tailwind
- Internal tools
- Workflow automation
- Prototyping
- Team collaboration
- Enterprise security
- GitHub integration
- Supabase
- SSO/SAML
- Production-ready apps
- No-code development
- Design-to-code

## Core Platform

- [Enterprise App Builder](https://lovable.dev/enterprise-landing): Enterprise platform for building collaborative AI apps with GitHub integration and SOC2 security.
- [Pricing](https://lovable.dev/pricing): Pricing plans for Lovable Pro, Cloud, and enterprise with credits system and team options.
- [Security](https://lovable.dev/security): Enterprise security features including SSO, SAML, Azure AD, and compliance standards.

## Use Cases by Role

- [For Founders](https://lovable.dev/founders): Lovable for founders: AI cofounder turning ideas into production apps with Supabase.
- [For Product Managers](https://lovable.dev/product-managers): Lovable for PMs: build interactive prototypes in minutes with React and Tailwind.
- [For Designers](https://lovable.dev/designers): Lovable for designers: design-to-code with AI image generation and full visual control.
- [For Internal Tools](https://lovable.dev/tools): Lovable for internal tools: custom workflows without engineering, ready in days.
- [For Prototypers](https://lovable.dev/prototypes): Lovable for prototypers: turn tickets and docs into working prototypes with full fidelity.
- [For Operations](https://lovable.dev/ops): Lovable for ops: automated workflows and live dashboards replacing status chasing.
- [For HR & People](https://lovable.dev/people): Lovable for HR: employee portals, onboarding workflows, and approval automation.
- [For Marketers](https://lovable.dev/marketers): Lovable for marketers: build landing pages and campaign products with HubSpot integration.
- [For Sales](https://lovable.dev/sales): Lovable for sales: create custom demos and ROI calculators for deal acceleration.
